guidelines: 1. One-time/ Fixed Asset expense should cover all compliance, fixed assets that are procured across departments (provisioning for only one month to be done)
2. Logistics remarks has to be put clearly keeping in mind the credit note settlements and time frames involved
3. SaaS cost has to be considered on a monthly basis (breakdown of quaterly, projections of actual usage and right month indexation is important)

4. Staffing cost to be broken into Warehousing, Omni & Quick Com and HQ (Maintain a sheet of headcount for the month as well tagged to all the three sub groups of staffing) - overtime expense to be included in the staffing cost (reimbursements will also be a line item to be tracked separately)
5. Packing costs are guestimates at channel level >> actuals exclusive to only warehousing vendors to be provided (this includes Omni & Quick com packaging as well)
6. April to July projections can be skipped (past months)
7. If additional rows are added, formulaes needs to be dragged and adjusted
8. Non GST bill amount across all line items to be mentioned
